title: AutoActivationSettingsResponse
description: Auto-activation settings for a port project

auto_activation_mode.description: Auto-activation mode: DISABLED (manual), ASAP (immediate after DDD), SCHEDULED (specific datetime)

scheduled_activation_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime for scheduled activation (UTC). Only present when mode is SCHEDULED.

auto_activation_failure_count.description: Number of consecutive failed auto-activation attempts

max_retry_attempts.description: Maximum allowed retry attempts before auto-activation stops

retry_cooldown_minutes.description: Cooldown period in minutes between retry attempts

can_auto_activate.description: Whether auto-activation can run (not at max retries)
